addMediaDescription: Upload from your device or import a verified link into private storage.
title: Media
description: Store, organize, and reuse production files securely.
workspaceDescription: Files for {workspace} and media shared with this workspace.
uploadDescription: Choose files, review their details, then upload them to private storage.
dropFiles: Drop files here or choose from your device
dropHint: Images up to 50 MB, videos up to 1 GB, and documents up to 25 MB.
titlePlaceholder: Give this file a recognizable name
linkPlaceholder: Paste a Google Drive, OneDrive, or direct HTTPS link
linkNeedsConnection: Connect {provider} or make the file publicly downloadable before importing it.
linkReadyToCheck: The {provider} link passed secure checks and is ready to import into private storage.
linkUnsupported: Use a secure HTTPS link or connect a supported provider.
linkInvalidUrl: Use an HTTPS link to the actual file.
linkUnsafeHost: This link points to a private or unsafe host. Use a public downloadable link.
linkMissingLength: The source did not provide a safe file size. Use a direct downloadable link.
linkTooLarge: This file exceeds the allowed size for its type.
linkFetchFailed: The server could not download this file. Check its permissions or use a public direct link.
emptyDescription: Upload a file or import one from a supported source to start building this library.
noResultsDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
storageDestinationDescription: Uploads and verified link imports go directly to the selected private storage backend. The browser never receives storage credentials.
storageFileNameRule: File naming: the server generates an immutable ID-based object key and keeps your original filename only as catalog metadata. Downloads use the editable asset title plus the verified file extension.
trashConfirm: Move this media to trash? You can restore it for 30 days.
manageError: This media change could not be saved. Try again.
storageUnavailable: Storage is not ready. Ask an agency administrator to check Media storage settings.
forbidden: You do not have access to the media library.
unsupportedType: This file type is not supported. Choose an image, video, PDF, TXT, or DOCX file.
fileTooLarge: This file is larger than the allowed limit for its type.
uploadPermissionDenied: You do not have permission to upload to this workspace.
storageQuotaExceeded: This upload exceeds the agency storage allowance. Remove unused files or contact an administrator.
verificationFailed: The uploaded bytes did not pass storage verification. Try the upload again.
uploadExpired: The upload session expired before it could be completed. Start the upload again.
transferFailed: The file transfer failed. Check your connection and try again.
uploadError: This file could not be uploaded. Check the type, size, and storage connection, then try again.
duplicateDetected: A matching ready asset already exists in {workspace}. Uploading this file will create a separate asset.
linkError: This link could not be checked. Make sure it is HTTPS and accessible, or connect the provider.
